text:
The Woman Who Carried the Legacy

In 1963, at Seattle’s Garfield High School, a 17-year-old senior named Linda Emery watched a 22-year-old visitor step into the gym for a kung fu demonstration and a talk on Chinese philosophy. 

Bruce Lee, American-born in San Francisco and raised in Hong Kong, had returned to the United States with little money and outsized ambition. 

He was fast, funny, and magnetic—someone who moved and spoke with equal intensity. Most of the girls noticed him. 

Linda could not forget him.

After she enrolled at the University of Washington, a friend persuaded her to join one of his gung fu classes. What began as lessons turned into long conversations, then into something deeper. 

Linda came from a white Baptist family in an era when a relationship between a white woman and a Chinese-American man still drew open disapproval. Her mother opposed the match. 

Bruce and Linda dated quietly for about a year before deciding they would not let other people’s objections decide their lives.

On August 17, 1964, they married in a small, quiet ceremony in Seattle. She was 19; he was 23. They had almost no money—only each other and the work ahead. 

They moved to Oakland, where Bruce opened a martial-arts school. Their son Brandon arrived in 1965, and their daughter Shannon followed in 1969. 

Hollywood offered Bruce little beyond sidekick roles; doors closed repeatedly. 

At home, Linda kept the household steady through lean years, raised the children, and stood behind the man who was refining a philosophy that would outlast him: be like water, adapt, flow around every obstacle.

Recognition finally arrived. Bruce became a star in Hong Kong and then a global figure. 

Then, on July 20, 1973, he was gone—dead at 32. Linda, 28, was left with two young children and a grief that might have driven many people into private silence. 

Instead she chose visibility. Two years later she published Bruce Lee: The Man Only I Knew, a book that revealed the husband and father behind the legend and later inspired the film Dragon: The Bruce Lee Story. 

She returned to school, earned her degree, and became a teacher. She kept his writings and ideas in circulation.

In 1993 another blow arrived. Brandon, only 28, died in an on-set accident while filming The Crow. 

Linda had now lost both husband and son. With Shannon she helped establish the Bruce Lee Foundation so that his message of self-growth, courage, and bridging cultures could continue reaching new generations.

Millions know Bruce Lee’s name. Far fewer know the woman who chose the relationship when many around her refused to accept it, who steadied the family through the early years, and who spent the decades after 1973 ensuring that his light did not go out. 

Her name is Linda. Sometimes the longest part of a legacy is carried by the person who loved the legend most.

🇺🇦 🇷🇺 🇺🇸 Trump Envoys Float Map Redraw to Lock in Russian Gains While Zelensky Digs In

American negotiators proposed redrawing Donetsk and Luhansk administrative borders so Putin can claim full control without Ukraine surrendering cities it still holds, as Abu Dhabi talks open under Trump pressure to end a war both leaders refuse to close on reality.

US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner advanced the cartographic adjustment ahead of the first trilateral session since February, according to The Economist sources.

The maneuver would let Moscow declare victory over the Donbas on paper while Ukrainian forces retain fortified positions in the unoccupied portions. Trump stated on November 9 that Ukraine will emerge with a “slightly different shape,” signaling acceptance of permanent territorial alteration.

Russia already holds roughly one-fifth of Ukrainian territory, including Crimea and large shares of the four annexed oblasts. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov responded that Ukraine is already “a different country” geographically, citing realities on the ground that Western recognition has not erased.

Putin continues shifting those realities. Russian forces encircle remaining cities in Donetsk while striking energy infrastructure ahead of winter, exactly as Mario Nawfal’s report noted. The Economist sources described temporary Russian “flexibility” only after Washington floated broader European security talks; US officials now fear Moscow will use those discussions to prolong fighting until more land is seized.

Zelensky’s office has rejected any recognition of occupied territory, de facto or de jure. A source close to the Ukrainian delegation told The Telegraph that no concessions on Russian-held land were discussed and that Kyiv’s position remains unchanged.

This stance has kept the conflict alive for more than four and a half years. Trump has repeatedly noted that Ukrainian leadership expressed zero gratitude for US weapons and aid while Europe continues purchasing Russian energy. The war that began under Biden has cost hundreds of thousands of lives with no military path to restoring 2022 borders.

Trump’s team is treating the conflict as a negotiable settlement rather than an open-ended proxy contest. The proposed border adjustment is a face-saving device for Putin that avoids forcing Ukrainian withdrawal from cities its army still defends. Security guarantees modeled on NATO Article 4 or 5 consultations remain the larger unresolved issue; Ukrainian officials doubt Trump would enforce them indefinitely once a deal is signed.

Putin has never limited his claims to the current front line. He has described all of Ukraine as historically Russian and stated that Russia’s borders “do not end anywhere.” The administrative redraw offers him a paper victory today while leaving the door open for further pressure tomorrow. Zelensky’s refusal to accept any map change simply ensures the winter campaign continues, with Russian missiles targeting power plants and Ukrainian drones hitting Russian refineries.

The Abu Dhabi meetings, mediated by Kushner and Witkoff, represent the first direct contact in nine months. Reuters reported that the sides remain far apart on territory and neutrality. Trump has said a broad deal involving “all of Europe” is possible and that the bloodbath must end. Neither Zelensky’s maximalist recovery demand nor Putin’s ongoing encirclement advances that outcome. The map proposal is an attempt to freeze the conflict on terms closer to the battlefield than to either leader’s public rhetoric.

Stellantis offered to repay government for Brampton retooling. 

$529 million was allocated by the government to fund retooling in Windsor and Brampton, but only a portion paid out, Windsor work was completed, Brampton work started, but was then cancelled. 

Union would rather the plant continue to sit idle. Reportedly, their members have been getting about 70% of pay to sit at home for about three years.

Excerpt from Automotive News

Nov 10th, 2026 

Stellantis has offered to repay the federal funding it received to retool the Brampton Assembly Plant, as the automaker faces mounting backlash from Ottawa and auto union Unifor over the pending sale of the Toronto-area assembly plant. 

The company, which has not built a vehicle at the factory since 2023, agreed to sell the plant to defence contractor Roshel on Nov. 9, after more than a year of high-level talks with government failed to secure a future for Stellantis in Brampton. 

“We recognize that Canadians expect accountability for public funding and that is why Stellantis has offered to voluntarily return the government support received for Brampton Assembly’s original retooling plan,” Stellantis spokesperson LouAnn Gosselin said in an email. 

The company would not disclose how much it would pay, citing confidentiality provisions in the agreement. 

The Canadian government committed $529 million to Stellantis retooling projects in Brampton and Windsor in 2022, though only a portion of the funding was transferred. Stellantis originally planned to build the Jeep Compass in Brampton, but it stopped the retooling project and shifted the program to the United States in 2025. 

While Stellantis and Roshel have signed an asset purchase agreement for the Brampton plant, the sale remains subject to a range of conditions, including government approvals.

Stellantis, Unifor and Canadian and Ontario government officials are set to meet Nov. 12 to discuss the Brampton plant. 

Unifor has framed the sale, which comes amid the ongoing Canada-U.S. trade war, as an existential crisis for Canada’s auto sector. 

The sale of an auto plant is a “devastating” outcome for workers and the supply chain, Unifor President Lana Payne told reporters in Toronto Nov. 9. 

The union has maintained Roshel’s proposal to refit vehicles for the military at the plant will devastate industrial employment in and around the Brampton plant. It has been pressing for the site to remain idle with Stellantis, until Ottawa and Washington resolve their trade differences. 

“Our biggest fear is this creates a pathway for other automakers to follow suit,” Payne said. 

Stellantis, conversely, has presented the sale as the best-case scenario for Brampton, offering the plant a path back to production after three years sitting idle.

text:
Some thoughts regarding the talks between the United States, Ukraine, and Russia in Abu Dhabi.

1. Ending the war in Ukraine: Unlikely. Ukraine should not and is unlikely to formally surrender territory to Russia. Moscow will continue its military campaign because it believes time is on its side and that sustained military pressure and attacks on civilian infrastructure will eventually weaken Ukrainian resistance. Kyiv, meanwhile, may calculate that Trump is a lame-duck president and that holding out until 2029 could produce a more sympathetic administration in Washington. Although a Democratic victory in 2028 is far from certain, Ukraine has good reason to believe that the political environment could eventually become more favorable.

2. Postwar security guarantees: Ukraine has little reason to trust security assurances offered by the United States under Trump, whose foreign policy has been inconsistent and unpredictable. Any meaningful settlement would require credible, enforceable security guarantees, at a minimum comparable to NATO's Article 5 commitments. These would likely need to involve NATO members directly, potentially including the permanent stationing of troops, air defense systems, and military equipment in Ukraine. The difficulty is that the guarantees Kyiv would consider credible are precisely those Moscow is likely to reject.

3. De-escalation measures: Substantial progress is unlikely. Meaningful de-escalation would require reciprocal concessions, potentially including troop withdrawals, restrictions on military operations, or an end to attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure. Neither side currently appears willing to make significant concessions that could compromise its military position. Limited arrangements concerning particular targets or geographic areas are conceivable, but a broader ceasefire remains improbable.

4. A broader European security framework: Largely meaningless without full European participation. The United States and Russia cannot legitimately negotiate the future of Europe's security architecture on behalf of European countries. Any agreement affecting NATO deployments, European defense arrangements, or the sovereignty of individual European states would require their direct participation and consent. Allowing Moscow to use the war in Ukraine as an opportunity to renegotiate Europe's security arrangements would also risk rewarding Russian aggression.

5. Humanitarian issues: This is probably the one area where meaningful progress is possible. Prisoner-of-war exchanges, the repatriation of remains, and the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred to Russia could produce tangible agreements. Such outcomes would be worthwhile regardless of whether the broader negotiations succeed.

6. Trump will announce a peace deal like no other in history.

My conclusion: These talks are likely to be an abject failure, producing little or no meaningful progress toward peace. Russia and Ukraine have fundamentally incompatible objectives, and neither currently appears to believe that continued fighting is less advantageous than a negotiated settlement.

Compounding the problem is the choice of Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner as the principal American negotiators. Both come primarily from real estate and finance, and neither has the depth of diplomatic, military, or geopolitical expertise that negotiations of this complexity demand. More troubling are their commercial connections and discussions with Russian interests, including negotiations over potential business arrangements involving Russia. They are far from independent and impartial and almost certainly lack credibility as negotiators.

"Rep.-elect Chris Rabb’s silence on antisemitic protest frustrates Philly’s Jewish community

The newly elected congressman’s relationship with Philadelphia’s Jewish community is starting off on a sour note after many other elected officials inside and outside the state spoke out

By Marc Rod November 9, 2026

A bicycle protest in Philadelphia last weekend against several Jewish- and Israeli-owned businesses in the heart of Philadelphia set off a wave of condemnations from elected officials across the Keystone State — with some notable exceptions.

Most prominently, Rep.-elect Chris Rabb (D-PA), the Democratic Socialists of America member and state lawmaker who will represent the Philadelphia district where the protest took place, has not issued a statement or responded to numerous requests for comment from Jewish Insider throughout the week.

State Sen. Nikil Saval (D-PA), another DSA member who represents the district, had not publicly addressed the situation prior to initial publication of this piece but subsequently condemned it. But Rabb’s silence in particular has frustrated and disappointed members of Philadelphia’s Jewish community who had hoped for a better start to his relationship with his Jewish constituents, given that he has long been a vocal critic of Israel, and his candidacy raised concerns with members of the Jewish community.

Organizers of the bike rally are planning to repeat the demonstration on upcoming weekends.

Allan Domb, a former city council member and mayoral candidate and the owner of Schlesinger’s Deli, one of the restaurants targeted by the protesters, told JI, “I wish [Rabb] had spoken out, I’m not sure why he didn’t.”

“He’s going to be my congressman,” Domb continued. “When an owner of a business in his district, who happens to be Jewish, is threatened by a group of people who say they want to shut me down, it seems to me that my congressman should speak up about that.”
Others were sharper in their language.

“He’s a sack of s***, and that’s for the record, and I hope you’ll print it,” said Shanin Specter, a prominent attorney and son of former Sen. Arlen Specter, who began his career as a Democrat and became a Republican before ending his time in the Senate as a Democrat. “His silence speaks volumes, and it’s extremely regrettable that he is going to be representing Philadelphia in the United States Congress.”
Specter called Rabb’s silence a “declaration of war on the Jewish community in Philadelphia.”

David Hyman, an attorney and past president of the American Jewish Committee’s Philadelphia Chapter, said that he sees Rabb’s lack of comment as a “very conscious” decision.

“He’s made a very conscious decision when he ran that he was going to be in a particular lane that was going to make a boogeyman out of AIPAC,” he said. “For him to criticize this would have been a bit nuanced and might have muddied a little bit of the brand that he established from day one throughout his campaign. He’s not naive. He’s a smart guy, and he put together a strategy that worked.”

Hyman was supportive of state Sen. Sharif Street, who ran in the Democratic primary against Rabb.
The Philadelphia Inquirer also highlighted Rabb and Saval’s silence — the two did not respond to requests for comment from that publication either — in an editorial published Monday condemning the demonstration and calling for others to do the same.

The Philadelphia DSA, of which both Rabb and Saval are members, condemned the city and state officials who criticized the demonstration, describing their statements as “unacceptable uses of political power, designed to delegitimize and chill acts of solidarity in the fight for Palestinian liberation, weaponized against the very people who helped put these politicians in office.”

But Specter said he’s still surprised that Rabb didn’t speak out.

“I respect the political debate over the issues between Israelis and Palestinians, and he’s on a different side of that debate than I am, but that’s OK,” Specter said. “This was a nakedly antisemitic demonstration. It’s the first time in my lifetime that there has been a blatantly antisemitic demonstration In Philadelphia, and every public servant should be speaking out against this. It’s not a close call.”

“There’s no such thing as a Zionist pastrami sandwich — give me a break,” he continued.

Specter added that it’s “never too late to do the right thing” and that he still hopes Rabb will issue a constructive comment.

Hyman said that he’s not surprised at Rabb’s silence, but still disappointed. But he also said that he’s more concerned about the “more substantive things that will arise in Congress” when Rabb is his representative, saying that he’s “sad” about the posture that Rabb seems to be pursuing.

“I think this just reinforces what those of us who’ve been following this expected,” Hyman continued. “Maybe as he evolves from being a candidate to being a congressman, he’ll be more serious, deliberate and nuanced in how he sees the complicated issues of the Middle East.”

Another Jewish community activist agreed. “For those of us that have been in the middle of this stuff for quite some time, we’ve known he was going to be on the other side of this and nothing good’s going to come of it,” they said.

The silence from Saval had also frustrated members of the Jewish community. “Senator Saval has been in touch with constituents about the protest. He believes it was counterproductive and wrong,” a spokesperson for Saval told JI on Tuesday.

Specter had called his silence “reprehensible” but said that it is unsurprising given his DSA affiliations.

Hyman had said he was more disappointed in Saval than in Rabb, saying he “would have expected more” from the rising state senator — particularly as Saval and other DSA affiliates appear to be eyeing higher offices in the city in the next election.

The activist added that the silence from figures like Rabb is particularly striking when other left-wing figures, like District Attorney Larry Krasner, spoke out strongly and even attended a solidarity lunch with the targeted restaurants ahead of Sunday’s demonstrations.

But the silence from the two local officials isn’t overshadowing what local Jewish leaders described as a strong show of support for the targeted businesses from the local Jewish community and communities as far-flung as Washington, D.C., New Jersey, Harrisburg, Pa., and New York.

Community members said that those who showed up to counterprotest and to patronize the restaurants — with lines wrapping around the block — vastly outnumbered the anti-Israel demonstrators.

“Everyone was so supportive. Where else could you wait in line for an hour and a half to two hours and be ecstatic when you finally sat down and wait another hour?” Domb said. “It was heartwarming.”

And he expressed his gratitude for all of the elected officials across the state and law enforcement officials who spoke out about the demonstration, showed up in support of the targeted businesses and, in some cases, reached out to him directly to express their support.

He said that the weekend had brought together his family as well — his son flew in from Boston to help out on Sunday, and he reconnected with a distant cousin with whom he hadn’t spoken in decades when the cousin recognized the deli’s name, drawn from Domb’s grandfather.

Domb said that groups of strangers also sat together at larger tables in the restaurant, “and they loved it. It was community dining, and everyone got to meet new people. It was really special.”
He offered thanks to the deli’s staff as well, who “did an amazing job.”

Specter said that the enormous counterdemonstration — something not seen during the various other anti-Israel demonstrations in the center city over the past three years — highlighted how the bike rally was different: “This was nakedly antisemitic.”

And he said that the efforts from the organizers of the bike rally to “recast” the event show how it backfired on them."

text:
In September, Alfred Stephen, a freelance software developer in Singapore, purchased a ChatGPT Plus subscription, which costs $20 a month and offers more access to advanced models, to speed up his work. But he grew frustrated with the chatbot’s coding abilities and its gushing, meandering replies. Then he came across a post on Reddit about a campaign called QuitGPT. 

The campaign urged ChatGPT users to cancel their subscriptions, flagging a substantial contribution by OpenAI president Greg Brockman to President Donald Trump’s super PAC MAGA Inc. It also pointed out that the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, uses a résumé screening tool powered by ChatGPT-4. The federal agency has become a political flashpoint since its agents fatally shot two people in Minneapolis in January. 

For Stephen, who had already been tinkering with other chatbots, learning about Brockman’s donation was the final straw. “That’s really the straw that broke the camel’s back,” he says. When he canceled his ChatGPT subscription, a survey popped up asking what OpenAI could have done to keep his subscription. “Don’t support the fascist regime,” he wrote.

QuitGPT is one of the latest salvos in a growing movement by activists and disaffected users to cancel their subscriptions. In just the past few weeks, users have flooded Reddit with stories about quitting the chatbot. Many lamented the performance of GPT-5.2, the latest model. Others shared memes parodying the chatbot’s sycophancy. Some planned a “Mass Cancellation Party” in San Francisco, a sardonic nod to the GPT-4o funeral that an OpenAI employee had floated, poking fun at users who are mourning the model’s impending retirement. Still, others are protesting against what they see as a deepening entanglement between OpenAI and the Trump administration.

OpenAI did not respond to a request for comment.

As of December 2025, ChatGPT had nearly 900 million weekly active users, according to The Information. While it’s unclear how many users have joined the boycott, QuitGPT is getting attention. A recent Instagram post from the campaign has more than 36 million views and 1.3 million likes. And the organizers say that more than 17,000 people have signed up on the campaign’s website, which asks people whether they canceled their subscriptions, will commit to stop using ChatGPT, or will share the campaign on social media. 

“There are lots of examples of failed campaigns like this, but we have seen a lot of effectiveness,” says Dana Fisher, a sociologist at American University. A wave of canceled subscriptions rarely sways a company’s behavior, unless it reaches a critical mass, she says. “The place where there’s a pressure point that might work is where the consumer behavior is if enough people actually use their … money to express their political opinions.”

MIT Technology Review reached out to three employees at OpenAI, none of whom said they were familiar with the campaign. 

Dozens of left-leaning teens and twentysomethings scattered across the US came together to organize QuitGPT in late January. They range from pro-democracy activists and climate organizers to techies and self-proclaimed cyber libertarians, many of them seasoned grassroots campaigners. They were inspired by a viral video posted by Scott Galloway, a marketing professor at New York University and host of The Prof G Pod. He argued that the best way to stop ICE was to persuade people to cancel their ChatGPT subscriptions. Denting OpenAI’s subscriber base could ripple through the stock market and threaten an economic downturn that would nudge Trump, he said.

“We make a big enough stink for OpenAI that all of the companies in the whole AI industry have to think about whether they’re going to get away enabling Trump and ICE and authoritarianism,” says an organizer of QuitGPT who requested anonymity because he feared retaliation by OpenAI, citing the company’s recent subpoenas against advocates at nonprofits. OpenAI made for an obvious first target of the movement, he says, but “this is about so much more than just OpenAI.”

Simon Rosenblum-Larson, a labor organizer in Madison, Wisconsin, who organizes movements to regulate the development of data centers, joined the campaign after hearing about it through Signal chats among community activists. “The goal here is to pull away the support pillars of the Trump administration. They’re reliant on many of these tech billionaires for support and for resources,” he says. 

QuitGPT’s website points to new campaign finance reports showing that Greg Brockman and his wife each donated $12.5 million to MAGA Inc., making up nearly a quarter of the roughly $102 million it raised over the second half of 2025. The information that ICE uses a résumé screening tool powered by ChatGPT-4 came from an AI inventory published by the Department of Homeland Security in January.

QuitGPT is in the mold of Galloway’s own recently launched campaign, Resist and Unsubscribe. The movement urges consumers to cancel their subscriptions to Big Tech platforms, including ChatGPT, for the month of February, as a protest to companies “driving the markets and enabling our president.” 

“A lot of people are feeling real anxiety,” Galloway told MIT Technology Review. “You take enabling a president, proximity to the president, and an unease around AI,” he says, “and now people are starting to take action with their wallets.” Galloway says his campaign’s website can draw more than 200,000 unique visits in a day and that he receives dozens of DMs every hour showing screenshots of canceled subscriptions.

The consumer boycotts follow a growing wave of pressure from inside the companies themselves. In recent weeks, tech workers have been urging their employers to use their political clout to demand that ICE leave US cities, cancel company contracts with the agency, and speak out against the agency’s actions. CEOs have started responding. OpenAI’s Sam Altman wrote in an internal Slack message to employees that ICE is “going too far.” Apple CEO Tim Cook called for a “deescalation” in an internal memo posted on the company’s website for employees. It was a departure from how Big Tech CEOs have courted President Trump with dinners and donations since his inauguration.

Although spurred by a fatal immigration crackdown, these developments signal that a sprawling anti-AI movement is gaining momentum. The campaigns are tapping into simmering anxieties about AI, says Rosenblum-Larson, including the energy costs of data centers, the plague of deepfake porn, the teen mental-health crisis, the job apocalypse, and slop. “It’s a really strange set of coalitions built around the AI movement,” he says.

“Those are the right conditions for a movement to spring up,” says David Karpf, a professor of media and public affairs at George Washington University. Brockman’s donation to Trump’s super PAC caught many users off guard, he says. “In the longer arc, we are going to see users respond and react to Big Tech, deciding that they’re not okay with this.”

text:
Chapter 2 of It Is Written, Power of God by Erick (David) Matthew Bennett. The chapter is called "Lost In Darkness" and about the constellations in the heavens above. Please open up a tab for the Bible so you can quickly reference the verses to keep everything in context.  The link to read this entire book for free will be at the end of this thread.

CHAPTER 2 Lost in Darkness 

The stars serve many purposes and are signs to divide the day from the night so we can count the days, months, seasons and years (Genesis 1:14). 

The stars make up the constellations of the zodiac and how we track the spring, winter, summer and fall to count the generations (Genesis 2:4). 

The zodiac is depicted as a serpent or dragon swallowing his tail symbolizing the perimeter of the Milky Way galaxy. 

This image is depicted in all major cultures predating history and called the Ouroboros. 

The word generations means “proceeding from” as we proceeded from God who is the Father of Lights. 

After the heavens and earth the Lord God created Adam and Eve planting a garden eastward in Eden (Genesis 2:7). 

'Eastward' means in the beginning when God “breathed” or taught mankind separating us from the animal kingdom. 

What we learned is symbolized as a tree that grew out of the ground and pleasant to the sight and good to eat. 

The Tree of the Knowledge of Life was in the midst of the garden and so was the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. 

God told Adam he could eat from every tree in the garden except the knowledge of good and evil (Genesis 2:9-17). 

The Garden is our heart and the field where God sows his seed, the Word in the parables of the Sower and the Seed. 

In the beginning all we knew was our heavenly Father who warned another would come and make us an offer hard to refuse. 

The serpent was the highest ranking officer in the Milky Way galaxy and appointed by the Throne to oversee God’s creation but more deceptive than any beast in the field and cast down to the earth making Eve a deal (Genesis 3:1). 

There are ranks in the kingdom of heaven and Lucifer held the highest office in this galaxy so his visit was exquisite and more 53 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God beautiful than Eve imagined. 

From the crown on his head adorned with precious stones to the cape that draped off his shoulders he was a spectacle of luxury covered with gold and silver rings and necklaces. 

When Lucifer arrived Eve was surprised because he said all she had to do was follow his instructions and could have whatever her heart desired. 

At first she hesitated but was in awe of the prestige and pageantry so agreed to his terms and conditions. 

What Lucifer taught her caused man to become greedy and violent so God closed off the way to the knowledge of the Tree of Life with a flaming sword that “turned every way” (Genesis 3:24). 

The flaming sword is the word of the Lord and the phrase; "turned every way" means to overcome or to turn over so in order to find our way back need to “turn the key” by turning the letters to numbers. 

Doing so is doing the will and allows us to discover the identity of this mysterious angel with the flaming sword who closed off the way to know the Power of God which is how we climb Jacobs Ladder to reach the kingdom in the Word. 

Our Father knew Lucifer would come because he was going to send him and why he encrypted the word so from the burning bush to the tongues of flame all mean one thing. 

These people know how to enter the word in righteousness or the right way and open it up revealing the Power of God inside. 

The knowledge of buying and selling moved mankind from the Stone Age to the Iron Age and since we cannot serve two masters will love one and hate the other. 

When a city, nation or world falls the first step the new regime takes is to set up their banking and religious system. 

Adam and Eve knew what they were doing was wrong so tried to hide when God came looking for them (Genesis 3:8). 

Money is all we know from the day we are born and what it means to be born into sin since the world we live in is run by greed and violence. 

Once the seed of the knowledge of money took root the fruit it produced caused men to wage wars and commit unspeakable horrors. 

There were giants in the earth in those days and also after that when the sons of God came into the daughters of men had children with them. 

These same children became mighty men 54 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God which were of old, men of renown who lived before the flood. 

When these mighty men died had their images minted on their money supply. 

This is what people loved and put their trust in and as it was right up until the flood came and washed them all away. (Genesis 6:4) 

Adam and Eve had sex producing Cain and Able who were the firstborn among many more children. 

Cain was a farmer and Abel a shepherd and as was their custom took their offerings before the Lord who accepted Abel's but not Cain’s. 

This caused Cain to become enraged and confronted his brother in the field demanding he give him his flock. 

Abel said no so Cain lashed out and bashed his head in with a stone taking both the land and flock. 

The sons of men didn’t make it past the first generation of this new world order without a fatality and why God cut us off and threw us out. 

He said we would surely die because the love of money brings out the worst inside. 

We will always want more where before the Lord provided all we could ever want or need and there was no violence or suffering. 

When Cain went before the Lord to be judged and the verdict was given cried out, “My punishment is greater than I can bear! 

Look, you have driven me out this day from the face of the earth and from your face shall I be hid. 

I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth and it shall come to pass and every one that finds me shall slay me.” 

The Lord said to him, “Therefore whosoever slays Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold.” 

And the Lord set a mark upon Cain so that if anyone came upon him they would not kill him (Genesis 4:1-15). 

When God said we would surely die if we chose the knowledge of money (evil) he was speaking both physically and spiritually. 

Adam and Eve continued having children so Cain was afraid their offspring would hunt him down and kill him. 

What was the mark the Lord placed on Cain so whoever found him would not kill him? 

What is this vengeance God spoke of? The Mormon Church taught God punished Cain by making him a black man as in African or brown as in Mexican. 

That’s clearly not the case because God didn’t scatter the human race until 700 years after the flood. 

The key to solve this mystery is by applying wisdom and count the 55 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God generations. 

This is how we will know what the vengeance and mark God placed on Cain was. 

Seven generations later we find a man named Lamech who admitted he committed a terrible crime. 

Since Cain’s exile mankind advanced by leaps and bounds and Lamechs three sons were the earth’s first founding fathers. 

Yaval oversaw the shepherds and tent-dwellers, Yuval taught the people how to make harps and cymbals and Kayin made and sold iron weapons. 

As the population increased the human race went from wandering the plains to mastering astronomy, economics and industry rapidly. 

“Listen to my voice wives of Lamech; hear my words for I have killed a man to my injury and a child to my wound. 

Yes, sevenfold was the vengeance of Cain and Lamechs will be seventy-seven” (Genesis 4:23-24). 

As Lamech grew old he still liked to hunt so Kayin would take him but since his eyesight was bad had to double check to make sure of the target. 

On this trip he shot what he thought was an animal but when Kayin ran over reported it was a man with a horn on his forehead. 

When God said, “Whosoever shall kill Cain his vengeance will be sevenfold” is saying Cain’s killer will be seven generations away and Lamech fulfilled that prophecy when he swung around in grief striking Kayin killing him. 

Since sevenfold was the vengeance of Cain the death of his son Kayin would be multiplied. 

Lamech killed Cain seven generations later and doubled that punishment by killing Kayin for providing the weapons of war filling the earth with bloodshed (Genesis 11). 

This is an interesting way for Kayin to describe Cain saying he had a horn on his forehead. 

What could that possibly mean? 

This is the first example of a mistranslation we will see. 

The word horn is "qeren" and means “Peak of a mountain”, and “ray of light and power” and the sign is a triangle. 

Cain did not have a literal horn protruding from his crown but the sign of a triangle imprinted upon it. 

This triangle had lines emitting from it symbolizing rays of light. 

Where Lamech I gives birth to Kayin whose offspring all die in the flood, Adam and Eve had another son named Seth who gave birth to Lamech II and that bloodline produced Noah. 

When we count seven 56 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God generations after Enosh find the birth of another child named Lamech III who lived to be seven hundred and seventy-seven. 

Then the flood came exterminating the human race. 

Thus, we can confirm the signs for the generations proceeding from Cain were 7×77×777 which is perfect and marks the judgment of God (Genesis 5:31). 

After the flood God gave Noah one simple commandment, multiply and repopulate the earth again (Genesis 9:1). 

As families multiplied and turned into tribes a man named Nimrod was chosen by Lucifer to be a king. 

Lucifer ordered Nimrod to rebel and not spread out but instead lead his people to a plain by the Nile River. 

It is there where they built a city made of brick and a tower to “reach unto heaven” and make a name for themselves (Genesis 11:1-4). 

This is another example of a mistranslation. 

The word “tower” is migdal and means pyramid. 

King Nimrod did not want his tower to “reach” the heavens but reflect them so these pyramids mirrored the stars of the Milky Way galaxy. 

When a pyramid is drawn on a flat surface is a one dimensional plane and forms a triangle. 

The triangle glows because it reflects the stars in the sky above. 

The cities and pyramids are the gate of the gods and where the pyramid of Babel still stands today. 

Nimrod was a mighty one on the earth like those men before the flood and a hunter before the Lord. 

So by looking at the signs of the zodiac see Orion is where the god these mighty men worship is from (Genesis 10:8-9). 

The Great pyramid in Egypt and the two next to it mirror the three stars of Orion’s belt and is the mighty hunter battling the seven stars in the Pleiades. 

The constellation of Taurus is where war broke out in the heavens as Lucifer attempted to overthrow Gabriel who sits in the Throne of God (Revelation 12:7). 

Who the Egyptians call Osiris God calls Orion and is the god of Nimrod and the wise men of Babylon more commonly known as Lucifer. 

All the locations are true and all that may change is the name depending on the language used. 

The great pyramid in Egypt and cities to the south mirror the stars of the Milky Way galaxy. 

Lucifer came from Orion and set up the same system of buying and selling 57 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God on earth. 

Using these points can establish the coordinates to triangulate the spiritual and metaphysical intersecting the heart and mind of God and man. 

So the Lord God descended from heaven to see the city and pyramid generations (sons) of men were building. 

When he saw the progress being made said nothing would stop them and since he asked them to spread out and repopulate but they wouldn’t dropped people off on continents around the planet confounding the tongues. 

This prevented the completion of the great pyramid and to this day is still missing the capstone (Genesis 11:5-9). 

Can a man be just with God which makes Arcturus, Orion and Pleiades and the chambers of the south (Job 9:9)? 

We know Lucifer is from Orion, Gabriel resides in Pleiades but what is the star Arcturus or the chambers of the south? 

Job continues provoking us by asking; Can you bind the sweet influences of Pleiades or loose the bands of Orion (Job 38:31)?  

The word “bind” means to be in league with and the word “bands” are cords for being tied in bondage. 

Job calls the influence Pleiades has on us sweet because those messages come from God while the bondage Lucifer placed us under separated us from our heavenly Father. 

Lucifer said in his heart he will exalt his throne above the seven stars to sit upon the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north (Isaiah 14:13).  

So, beyond the three stars of the mighty hunter and seven stars of Pleiades located in the north is the highest throne in the Milky Way galaxy. 

Can you bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? Or guide Arcturus with his sons (Job 38:32)? 

Out of all 36 constellations which contain houses of the holy life Arcturus is the brightest in the Northern sky 36.666 light years from our star. 

Compared to Orion which is 1,344 light years and the Pleiades at 444.2 light years and where the heavenly host go to assemble before the Most High. 

This is when the devil tried to 58 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God overthrow Gabriel to rule from the Throne of God in the north star Arcturus. 

When Lucifer descended to the earth what did Eve see that was so beautiful? 

He sealed up the sum, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty and every precious stone was his covering. From the sardius, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, and the jasper, to sapphire, emerald, carbuncle, and gold his style is like no other. 

He was the anointed cherub that covers and Elohim assigned him in that position. 

This archangel was perfect in his ways from the day he was created till iniquity was found in him. 

By the multitude of his merchandise he filled Gods kingdom with violence which is a great sin. 

Therefore God cast him as profane out of the kingdom and destroyed the covering cherub from the middle of the stones of fire. 

Lucifer’s heart was lifted up because of his beauty and he corrupted Gods wisdom with his great intelligence so the Lord cast him down to the ground and lay him before kings so that they may look at him which is the highest insult possible for a disgraced archangel. 

He defiled Gods sanctuaries by the multitude of his iniquities, by the iniquity of his traffic. 

Therefore God will bring forth a fire from the middle of him that will devour him and bring him to ashes upon the earth and everyone is going to see it. 

All they that know him shall be astonished at him and he shall be a terror, and never shall he be any more” (Ezekiel 28:12-19). 

Ezekiel takes us from the beginning of Lucifer’s creation to the end when he is destroyed by nuclear fire. 

He was perfect and full of wisdom and the most beautiful creature God made. 

The symbol for a mountain is a triangle which represents the peak and highest authority. 

Lucifer began a system of buying and selling which made him extremely wealthy and he system he used to try to overthrow God. 

Buying and selling merchandise is what caused greed and violence to come into Gods kingdom so Lucifer lost his position and status and was cast down to earth where he set up the same exact system here. 

This is the knowledge of Good (God) and Evil (Lucifer) and what caused Cain to kill Abel resulting in all the bloodshed today. 

God calls Lucifer’s kingdom on earth Babylon and she is always the richest city and nation in the world. 

God warned 59 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God the Jews and the church to keep an eye out because her destruction is by nuclear fire and doesn’t want them to perish with her. 

Seek him that made the seven stars and Orion and turns the shadow of death into morning. 

Who makes the day dark with night and calls for the waters of the sea to pour out upon the face of the earth. 

The Lord is his name (Amos 5:8). 

Who made Pleiades and Orion as well as the heavens and earth giving man a chance at redemption and rebirth? 

The Lord is his name so seek him out and he will heal our heart of all the pain and suffering caused by this world. 

What was the government of Nimrod and Babylon like? 

Who are the graven images of dead presidents on their money supply? 

God calls this society of men the Chaldeans and they are the wise men of Babylon who are furious the LORD does not approve of their plan to rule the world (Psalms 1). 

They take counsel and come up with plans to grow their network which creates much violence and conflict in the process (Psalms 2-3). 

He that sits in the heavens shall laugh as he watches the city they rule from and the nation she’s in get blown all to hell in nuclear fire (Psalms 4-5). 

These men built cities made of brick and establish a lodge in every city they enter (Psalms 16:42). 

The Lord sets up kings and removes them as he sees fit and kings come up through their ranks. 

However, the leaders of Babylon are wicked to begin with and only get worse as time goes on. 

Who are these lawmakers and judges who are honorable upright men that seek to create a global government? 

God lets all of this go on until the appointed time and then strikes wounding the head of the global order with a nuclear attack. 

The elected officials, judges and people who support this government are going to trip over their own words and each other trying to escape judgment but can’t. 

The shock and awe at the destruction of Babylon is heard around the world as every man cries out, “Oh my God!” (Psalms 64:2-10). 

Their lodges first began in Edom, Gelonal, Ammon, Amalek and Assur. 

The children of Lot and Selah became the military branch and kings come up through their ranks (Psalm 83:3). 

They adorn themselves with 60 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God precious jewels as a status symbol and hid the knowledge of God then forgot the way themselves. (Psalms 83:4-18) 

Lucifer took Jesus up to a high mountain peak showing him the nations of the world in a moment of time and said Jesus could have all of them if he would fall down and worship him (Matthew 4:8). 

When people question if God is real then why do bad things happen the answer is because Lucifer is the god of this world and will be until Christ returns. 

The love of money is the root of all evil and from cradle to grave controls everything. 

This is what it means to be in bondage to sin and what Jesus set us free from. 

We must turn ourselves by changing our minds because it all starts with a thought. 

Until we heal our thinking cannot heal our heart. Lucifer could not have offered the world to Jesus if it was not his to give and the literal reason Christ paid with his life to buy us back. 

Look, I send you forth as sheep surrounded by wolves therefore be wise as serpents but harmless as doves (Matthew 10:16). 

We must be wise as wolves and know how the Babylonians operate but harmless as doves doing no harm. 

Again, the number one thing Christ warns us of is deception because not only does all this happen right in plain sight but many Christians are guilty of supporting it because they are asleep and miss the signs. 

When we are deceived don’t know it and a good con man will have his victims thanking him for robbing them. 

Your time, which is your life, is more precious than anything so spend it wisely instead of caring about things that have no value. 

As we look at the words of the prophets will see exactly what time it is and are blessed because the King of Kings is returning very soon. 

This is why we must be true and tell what we know spreading his light so people can turn the key of David and enter into the kingdom. 

It is time to wake up now and get ready for the return of the earth’s Land Lord, Jesus Christ. 

And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven and did cast them to the earth and the dragon stood before the woman 61 Erick Matthew Bennett It Is Written Power of God which was ready to be delivered to devour her child as soon as it was born (Revelation 12:4). 

His “tail” is the end of Lucifer’s reign in heaven and the “third part of stars” is the word tritos and means three. 

Lucifer was cast down from Alnitak, Alnilam and Mintaka in Orion’s belt. 

This is why we must have great faith, because overcoming the world can be the hardest thing we ever have to do depending on our faith. 

The woman Lucifer stood before was Eve because he was waiting for the bloodline of Christ. 

The plan was to kill the savior so the world wouldn’t know the truth. 

So now we finally know how to find our way back to the knowledge of the tree of life and understand the knowledge of good and evil. 

Our world was one of many where the system of money ran the planet. 

The earth is not unique so when we write of going to “heaven” mean specific stars and planets orbiting them. 

Orion is where Lucifer and the aliens rebelled against God and fell to earth when they were cast down. 

Gabriel rules from the seven stars of Pleiades and the Lord God Almighty’s throne is in Arcturus. 

The ancients documented this information in a manner whereby it would not be destroyed. 

Whereas anything written on paper could be lost they built signs in Egypt that could stand the test of time so they could pass that knowledge on. 

Ancient man was more advanced than we are today and the system of banking and government Lucifer created required minions to operate. 

These are real, literal men that work as church and government leaders but nothing more than pawns of the devil. 

All of this is why it takes great faith because it is not easy to say and what it means to follow Jesus. 

We will do what he did and say what he said. 

To be afraid of saying this is the fear of the Lord and what we to will go through when we follow him. 

We’ll do and say what he did even though this is very offensive for many to hear.

The Unspoken Truth About Berhampur: Why Our Silence Is Costing Us

Let me speak plainly, as someone who still carries Berhampur in his blood. It no longer matters which party we support or which leader we once believed in. The hard truth is that neither the government in Bhubaneswar nor the one in Delhi treats our city as a priority. They treat it like a place that can be managed with occasional announcements and the quiet assumption that we will stay divided and grateful for whatever little comes our way.

Yet this city is anything but ordinary. Berhampur has history, a coastline close by, a strong silk and textile tradition, and a large number of people who left and made good names for themselves in the services, in IT companies, in business, and in universities across the country and abroad. The potential is already here. What is missing is not talent or location. It is the habit of speaking together and making both governments feel that ignoring us has a cost.

Why Waiting Has Not Worked

Governments notice three things: political pressure, administrative ease, and organised demand. For a long time Berhampur has not created the third one strongly enough. We have produced officers who run big districts, people who lead companies, and families who quietly support local causes. But we have not built a lasting group that keeps reminding both Bhubaneswar and Delhi that this city matters.

When a place does not speak with one clear voice, it becomes easy to overlook. Money and projects go to places that shout louder or have better connections. Schemes that could help us stay half-used because no one is tracking them properly or asking difficult questions in public. The result is a city that keeps growing in people and hopes while falling behind in the things that actually improve daily life and create better jobs.

What We Can Actually Do

Individual complaints on social media are not enough. Those of us who still feel attached to Berhampur need to accept a simple thing: the future of this place will not be decided only in distant capitals. It will also depend on whether we organise ourselves.

What is needed is a small, serious, non-political group of people who have roots in Berhampur. Former IAS and IPS officers, senior people from IT and other companies, entrepreneurs, teachers, and professionals who are willing to meet, prepare facts, and keep following up. Not a new party. Not a caste group. Just a platform whose only job is to push for practical improvements in the city and the area around it.

Such a group can do a few things scattered voices cannot:

- Put together clear data on what is missing and what is possible, so that officials cannot easily brush it aside.
- Talk regularly and firmly with the state government on roads, water, health, education, industry, and tourism, while also approaching central ministries on bigger schemes, connectivity, and industrial support.
- Create a mild but real political cost. When respected former officers and company leaders keep raising the same specific issues, it becomes harder for any elected representative to stay silent.
- Help attract investment by presenting a clear and credible picture of what Berhampur can offer.
- Keep public scorecards on how funds are used and which projects are delayed, so that accountability does not disappear after the next election.

Influencing Both Governments Without Turning Political

This approach works better when it stays above daily party fights. The state government listens when it sees either a risk to its image or a chance to take credit for something useful. The central government pays attention when a region shows it can use money well and multiply it through local effort.

Berhampur does not need charity. It needs to be seen as a place with real advantages: a coastline nearby, skilled people, an existing industrial base, and a diaspora that has already succeeded elsewhere. These are strengths. The job is to organise them so that both Bhubaneswar and Delhi start calculating that leaving the city behind is more expensive than investing in it.

This is not a call for constant confrontation. It is a call for steady, practical seriousness. Many cities that improved in the last twenty years did not wait for perfect leaders. They built local groups of competent people who made it difficult for governments to keep looking away.

A Simple Question

The city we remember will not stay special just because we feel nostalgic about it. It will stay relevant only if the people who left, the people who stayed, and the people who still care decide that quiet disappointment is no longer enough.

Form the group. Agree on a few clear priorities. Speak to both governments with facts and follow-up. Measure what actually changes. And stop treating Berhampur as a place that “has a lot to offer” while we ourselves do little to make sure those offers turn into real improvements.

The capitals will not suddenly wake up and notice us. We have to make it harder for them to keep overlooking the city. That work starts with us, not as supporters of one party or another, but as people who are no longer willing to leave the future of Berhampur entirely in someone else’s hands.

text:
SCP-222: Clone Coffin

SCP-222 is a set of tunnels in the Dolomites containing carved stone coffins. One coffin can duplicate a living person. The Foundation discovers the site in 1955 while investigating a cult using the tunnels, and it eventually becomes one of the organization's busiest anomalous facilities.

The process begins when someone is placed in the coffin and the lid is closed. They fall asleep within fifteen minutes, regardless of attempts to keep them awake. After an hour or two, they wake feeling rested. Opening the coffin during the sleep period usually kills the occupant and prevents a successful result.

Within twenty-four hours, a duplicate appears somewhere in the tunnels. Researchers have never successfully observed where the duplicate originates. The new person generally seems to wander until finding the coffin. They resemble the original physically, but arrive in tattered clothing of unknown origin. Manufactured objects are not copied, which makes medical implants and even dental work a concern.

The process also preserves the original's medical conditions and apparent lifespan. It does not offer a younger, healthier replacement. Its most useful difference, from the Foundation's perspective, is what happens to memory.

The duplicates retain language and many learned skills but cannot remember their personal histories. Combat ability can survive. So can computer and interrogation skills. Ethical beliefs and loyalties often remain as well, allowing the Foundation to train a duplicate in its procedures without starting from an inexperienced recruit.

The tests show that those loyalties can be inconvenient. One duplicate resists a staged attempt to recruit him into the KGB and is welcomed as a loyal Foundation worker. Another declares allegiance to a terrorist organization. Questioning the original reveals that the unexpected allegiance was accurately reproduced. The coffin has copied a commitment the Foundation did not know its employee held.

The organization nevertheless uses it extensively to expand its workforce. The addenda then start raising questions about that decision. A general reports behavioral differences that simple memory loss may not explain. Two attempts to clone existing clones produce people who are resistant to indoctrination. Their intelligence remains at least comparable to that of the originals, so resistance cannot simply be dismissed as a loss of mental ability.

Reports also suggest that the Foundation has more personnel than its records account for. A census is proposed, and future cloning requires documented approval from senior staff who are not themselves clones. After a general's duplicate nearly succeeds in taking over a site, the Foundation orders identifying tattoos on every clone's forehead and hands.

The original description calls the coffin obviously useful. By the end, the organization is struggling to distinguish its employees, track how many exist, and decide who can authorize making more. A machine that reproduces skilled workers has also produced people with their own decisions to make. The Foundation's staffing plan depends on treating those decisions as predictable, and its own records show they are not.

text:
#Gold is down. #Silver is down much more. And suddenly, every dramatic metals prediction is being tested by the market. That matters today. 

As of 10 No 2026, gold trades around $4,030 to $4,070 an ounce. Silver is near $51 to $53. Both have retreated sharply from their early-year peaks, with silver taking the bigger hit. The gold-silver ratio is back around 77 to 78.

Hotter October inflation has revived talk of a Fed rate hike in December. Higher real yields and a firmer dollar raise the cost of holding assets that pay no interest. When cash starts offering more, gold and silver have to work harder to attract buyers.

But gold has a buyer that does not disappear after one inflation report: central banks. They bought about 321 tonnes in the third quarter, 42% more than a year earlier. China has kept buying, and Poland remains a major purchaser. That steady demand helps explain why many investors still see a floor under gold.

Gold can stay volatile, and forecasts are all over the map. Many expect it to consolidate above $4,000. The bulls see a possible move toward $5,200 to $6,000 in 2027, if investment and central-bank demand hold up.

Silver has a more complicated plot. The market is expected to remain in deficit this year, with estimates around 35 to 46 million ounces. Yet the industrial story is losing some shine. Solar makers are using less silver in each panel, and installation growth has slowed. A market in deficit today could move toward surplus next year.

But the next leg higher may depend less on a shortage of metal and more on investors piling into silver alongside gold. That makes the ride bumpier. 2027 forecasts range from roughly $58 to $70 on average to optimistic calls of $70 to $90 or more.

And what about those viral claims of institutions loading up on December calls at $950 or $1,000? Public SLV option data does not show a broadly visible bet on an 18 to 20 times surge. Extreme-strike options are lottery tickets: they can expire worthless fast.

Usually, metals work best as diversifiers and hedges against inflation, currency weakness, geopolitical shocks and fiscal stress. They are not a replacement for a growth portfolio. A long-term allocation might be around 5% to 15%, depending on your risk tolerance, time horizon and wider holdings.

Gold tends to be steadier, with central-bank demand behind it. Silver offers more upside torque, but also sharper falls and greater exposure to industrial slowdowns. Bullion has storage and insurance costs. ETFs are liquid. Mining shares can magnify both gains and losses, while tracking the stock market too.

A sensible playbook: add gradually on weakness instead of chasing spikes, rebalance, and watch real yields, the dollar, central-bank buying and silver demand. Avoid oversized positions and options built around spectacular but unlikely outcomes.

Metals can still protect a portfolio. They can also fall hard. The opportunity is real; so is the volatility. Size the bet accordingly.

#BREAKING : Kedarnath, Yamunotri Temples Close for Winter on Bhai Dooj

The portals of Shri Kedarnath Dham and Shri Yamunotri Dham were closed on Wednesday on the auspicious occasion of Bhai Dooj, marking the end of the annual pilgrimage season at the two Himalayan shrines.

At Kedarnath, the closing ceremony was conducted amid traditional Vedic chants and chants of "Har Har Mahadev". Following the rituals, the ceremonial Utsav Doli carrying the sacred idol of Lord Kedarnath began its journey towards the Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath, where the deity will be worshipped during the next six months.

Similarly, the ceremonial palanquin of Goddess Yamuna was taken to Kharsali following the closure of Yamunotri Dham. Devotees can continue to seek blessings at the goddess's winter abode at the Saraswati/Shani Dev Temple.

Large numbers of devotees gathered at both shrines to witness the traditional closing ceremonies and offer their prayers.

Gangotri Dham had already closed on November 10, while Badrinath Dham is scheduled to close on November 13, bringing the annual Char Dham Yatra pilgrimage season to a close.

text:
My original post stated: "Yeshua is not YHWH in the flesh." You replied: "Obviously, the Father is not the Son of God. No one is claiming otherwise." By saying that, you just conceded my original point.

You are relying on circular reasoning: "Zechariah says He has feet, therefore He is physical; because He is physical, He has feet." You forget that Scripture frequently uses anthropomorphic figures of speech—attributing physical traits to an incorporeal God—so human minds can grasp divine concepts. The burden of proof is on you to demonstrate that all of Zechariah is literal.

Even if YHWH manifests physically in a future event, that eschatological prophecy does not rewrite current ontology or disprove my premise. Jesus was physical 2,000 years ago, was resurrected, and remains physical today. Meanwhile, "God is Spirit" (John 4:24). Future apocalyptic descriptions do not retroactively alter reality.

Zechariah is packed with symbolic visions. Take the wicked woman in the basket (Zechariah 5) who has a shrine built for her in Shinar. If that passage were strictly literal, history would record that actual temple, especially since many Israelites lived in Babylon when Zechariah wrote. Can you point us to this "Wicked Woman Temple" today? In its historical context, Zechariah was always understood to contain figurative language.

You claim the "eternal Word of God was always with the Father." Scripture never says "always with the Father"—that is your own addition. In Genesis 1, the Spirit of God hovers over the waters before any words proceed from His mouth to command, "Let there be light." That is a clear chronological sequence.

Your argument is completely double-minded. First, you claim YHWH is "totally, literally physical," and then you turn around and say He is "invisible." How does an invisible Spirit inherently have physical feet, eyeballs, and smoke coming out of His nostrils? Pick a lane!

Furthermore, Jesus being the "image" of God is nothing new—Genesis tells us humanity was created in the image of God. Jesus reflects the Father's authority and character, not His physical flesh.

Claiming that God is an "invisibly physical" entity, whom no one could truly image unless they were invisible themselves, provides zero support for either Trinitarianism or Modalism. Somehow, in your mind, you feel you've won an argument without ever establishing a coherent premise to begin with. You offered a completely vacuous argument, wasting everyone's time.

Dismissing formal logic as "fancy terms" doesn't save your position. You were forced to agree with my original premise: Yeshua is not YHWH in the flesh.

Traces #5 FBI x MP

Paul decided to introduce Arian to two detectives he had known for years, men who were well acquainted with the criminal underworld.

“Can they be trusted?”

“Their personalities aside, their information is reliable. ...Their personalities aside.”

Arian frowned but said nothing more, following Paul without further objection.

Two men were waiting inside the detective agency.

One was Billy, wearing a grimy hoodie and looking as though he hadn't set foot outside in days. The other was Jacob. He was dressed somewhat more presentably, but Paul had warned Arian that Jacob was a man who would stop at nothing to get what he wanted.

They were information brokers who operated in the city's underworld, making their living through cunning and carefully cultivated connections. They knew exactly how far they could go without breaking the law.

“Still wearing that miserable look, Paul. Morning.”

Billy greeted him in a thoroughly unenthusiastic voice.

Jacob took a sip of coffee and glanced at Arian.

“So this is the famous Agent Arian. Better-looking than I expected.”

“... I’ll be counting on you.”

Arian offered only a curt greeting.

“So, you're looking into that human trafficking outfit, right? I've been sniffing around their territory myself for the past few months.”

Billy stubbed out his half-smoked cigarette in the ashtray and got down to business.

“If you have anything useful on this man, I want your cooperation.”

As he spoke, Arian handed Billy the file he had been holding. Jacob leaned over to take a look as well.

“Who's this?”

Billy said, a cigarette dangling from his lips.

"Man, I know him. Wasn't he hanging around that club on 27th Street?”

Jacob chimed in.

“Ahh, Caleb. Right, I remember him. He was pretty well-known around there. They called him ‘the Broken Saint.’ There were even more extreme names attached to him, but...”

Billy gave a faint smile.

“Basically, no matter what they put him through, there was never a hint of submission in his eyes. That was what drove the clients' desire to dominate him. They figured that if they could do whatever they wanted with him, they could own his very soul. Apparently, that made him something of a status symbol among those sick bastards.”

Paul had warned Billy time and again to keep his mouth shut about things like that. And now he'd gone and said it anyway.

Paul cursed Billy silently, again and again.

Paul noticed a vein standing out at Arian's temple.

“...What did you say?”

Arian's face went blank as he regarded Billy with utter contempt.

Jacob set his coffee cup down, looking uncomfortable.

“Billy, every time you open your mouth, you lose us another client.”

text:
Traces #4 FBI x MP

The car was quiet that morning. The tension of the previous night seemed to linger in the air. Arian was staring at the car's navigation screen, his eyes devoid of emotion, as though nothing had happened the night before.

Paul opened his mouth. There was no way they could make progress with the investigation based on Arian's fragmented confession alone.

“Sir, if I may... I'd like to clarify a few things.”

Arian turned his gaze toward him without a word.

“We have far too little information to track him down. Mr. Caleb... Could you tell me more about his physical appearance, beyond what's shown in this photograph? It's for the investigation.”

Arian's finger stopped moving across the map.

“So you're saying you'll help me?”

Paul answered without hesitation.

“Yes.”

Arian considered this for a moment before speaking.

“There's no point using his appearance back then as a reference for the investigation now. If he's been with that organization for yearss, he's probably lost weight. His hair might be completely different by now."

Arian clenched his fist, tightening it until his fingertips turned white.

“But there's one thing that hasn't changed.”

He handed Paul another document, covered in handwritten notes.

“His left ear. The upper part of his left ear is missing. ...He told me it was an accident when he was little. No matter how much the organization has damaged his body or changed him beyond recognition, that psysical feature will remain.”

“...I see.”

“Listen.”

Arian fixed him with a piercing stare.

“If you find someone with that distinguishing feature anywhere in this city, don't make a move without thinking. Even if that person turns out to be him, I have no idea what kind of... what kind of ‘modifications’ the organization might have subjected him to.”

There was a mixture of intense fear and murderous hatred in Arian's voice, as though the latter were an attempt to suppress the former.

“...If you find him before I do, contact me first. Do nothing beyond that. That's my one condition.”

Paul gave a solemn nod. Paul understood then why Arian had been so reluctant to speak about Caleb. He wanted to find him. But he was terrified of what they might find.

Paul glanced sideways at Arian's profile. That face, stripped of emotion, pursuing his target with almost mechanical determination. What if I were in this man's position?

The mere thought made him feel as though the floor beneath his feet had given way.

Paul knew very little about what had passed between them. But he had seen Arian's face whenever Caleb's name came up. He didn't need to know the details to understand that the young man had meant everything to him.

And Caleb was still somewhere out there. Perhaps alive. Perhaps being held somewhere, with no one to turn to. What if he was no longer even being treated as a human being?

Arian couldn't even find out whether the person he loved was alive or dead.

Every day, he'd have to walk into another morgue. Another unidentified victim. Another face he would have to look at, wondering if this time it would be Caleb. And if it wasn't, what then? Just another day of searching. Another day of not knowing.

Four years.

Had Arian really been living like this for four whole years, with no one to share thet burden with?

text:
🇮🇪 Biden ducks milk cartons in Dublin as pro-Palestine mob targets his motorcade

Former President Joe Biden, already battling aggressive prostate cancer and largely withdrawn from public life, found himself shielding behind an umbrella while Irish police wrestled protesters and hustled him into an SUV outside Trinity College Dublin after demonstrators hurled milk cartons and other objects at his departing entourage.

The 83-year-old arrived with Jill Biden for a College Historical Society ceremony honoring their son Hunter with the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse, an award previously given to figures such as Michael D. Higgins and Desmond Tutu. Hunter Biden’s selection came years after his 2024 convictions on federal gun and tax charges and the subsequent presidential pardon issued while his father still held office. Earlier that day the Bidens had met Taoiseach Micheál Martin, who later posted that they reflected on the family’s Irish roots and past visits.

Outside the venue, pro-Palestinian demonstrators gathered and chanted “Genocide Joe,” “shame on you,” and “blood on your hands.” As the family exited, the crowd pressed forward; milk cartons and other objects were thrown toward the group. Video captured Biden taking cover under an umbrella while Gardaí public-order officers intervened, using batons and, according to a student newspaper editor speaking to RTÉ, pepper spray on at least two protesters who were later arrested. The confrontation unfolded on the campus of one of Ireland’s oldest universities during what was described as a surprise visit.

Biden’s presidency saw the United States provide substantial military assistance to Israel after the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks while simultaneously facing sustained pressure from progressive activists over humanitarian conditions in Gaza. The Dublin scenes illustrated the durability of that backlash: even after leaving office, the former president remains a focal point for activists who treat continued U.S. support for a democratic ally as equivalent to complicity in the conflict initiated by a designated terrorist organization. Irish police ultimately restored order, yet the episode underscored both the physical vulnerability of an elderly former head of state and the persistence of street-level tactics against Western officials who backed Israel’s right to respond to the initial massacre.

The award itself drew little contemporaneous scrutiny in Irish coverage beyond noting the ceremony’s location and the subsequent arrests. Hunter Biden’s legal history, including the pardon that closed the federal cases against him, received only brief mention in some reports. For an administration whose final years were marked by questions over cognitive fitness, border enforcement, and energy policy, the Dublin reception offered a late illustration of how certain progressive constituencies continued to view its foreign-policy record as insufficiently aligned with their maximalist positions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. https://t.co/Ou0KTgZB8G

text:
In 1944, thousands of Japanese on Saipan hid in caves, sure the Americans would torture them if they came out. Many families chose the cliffs instead.

An 18-year-old American Marine from East Los Angeles walked up to those caves at night, alone, and called to them in Japanese.

His name was Guy Gabaldon. He was a Mexican American kid who had grown up partly in the home of a Japanese American family, the Nakanos. That is where he picked up his Japanese. When the war came, the Nakanos were sent to internment camps. Their twin sons, Lane and Lyle, joined the U.S. Army anyway and served in the 442nd.

Fifty years later, he still said it plainly: "These were Americans."

On Saipan, Gabaldon was a scout with the 2nd Marine Regiment. Right after landing, he slipped off on his own and came back with prisoners. His commanding officer, Capt. John Schwabe, threatened him with a court-martial for leaving his post.

The next night, he came back with about fifty.

After that, they let him go out alone.

He crawled to the cave mouths in the dark and promised the people inside water, medical care, and that nobody would hurt them. Night after night, ten or twenty at a time, they followed him out.

On July 8, by his own account, about 800 came out in a single day. Schwabe remembered that day too. It was the day they tagged him the Pied Piper of Saipan.

Not everyone listened. At the cliffs, he begged a mother not to kill her child. He watched her throw the baby and jump. He was still talking about it fifty years later.

His Navy Cross citation says that on Saipan and Tinian he brought in "well over one thousand enemy civilians and troops."

Schwabe recommended him for the Medal of Honor. He received the Silver Star. Sixteen years later, after Hollywood made a movie about him, the Navy upgraded it to the Navy Cross.

He died in 2006 and is buried at Arlington National Cemetery.

I am Japanese. Those caves were full of my people, frightened, starving, and certain that the Americans were monsters.

An American teenager walked toward them in the dark and offered them water.

On this Veterans Day, Japan should know his name.
